rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst, but it overstates confidence from a single static image by asserting a clear tightly compact ICM and cohesive TE/A-range features that are not sharply demonstrable here; limited comment on zona thinning and image ambiguity.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior IVF failures/miscarriages, semen parameters, diagnosis, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with appropriate caveats about morphology versus aneuploidy and prior failures; only minor issue is some imprecision around implantation versus clinical pregnancy framing.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including caution about add-ons and consideration of uterine/RPL workup; slight overemphasis on PGT-A discussion in a very young patient keeps it from perfect alignment.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and structured future evaluation, though some recommendations remain broad rather than protocol-specific.
